shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && printf '\\n--- package/test config ---\\n' && rg --files -g '*test*' -g 'package.json' -g 'vitest*' -g 'jest*' | head -120"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts; printf '\\n--- existing orchestrator tests ---\\n'; sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; sed -n '1,120p' src/config.test.ts; printf '\\n--- config/scripts ---\\n'; cat package.json; printf '\\n'; sed -n '1,240p' .lore/test-commands.yml; printf '\\n--- lore files ---\\n'; ls -la .lore && [ -f .lore/dod.md ] && sed -n '1,220p' .lore/dod.md || true; printf '\\n--- anchors ---\\n'; rg -n 'specs/|spec:' src scripts .lore -g '*.test.ts' -g '*.mjs' -g '*.yml' | head -100"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short && cat jest.config.js && sed -n '1,220p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs && sed -n '1,220p' scripts/lore-run-test.mjs && rg -n 'specs/["'^ ]+#|spec:|specAnchor|anchor'"' src scripts -g '*.test.ts' -g '*.mjs' | head -160"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' src/providers/mock/mockProvider.ts; sed -n '1,180p' src/providers/mock/mockProvider.test.ts; rg -n 'class Mock|createMock|reject|sendMessage' src/providers src/types/ai.ts | head -100; git log --oneline -8"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'specs/|#\\d+|specAnchor|validated by' src --glob '*.test.ts' | head -100; rg -n 'tests.list|descriptor|spec' .lore scripts -g '*.mjs' -g '*.yml' | head -120; git branch --show-current && git remote -v"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write .lore/dod.md && git add .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/onError.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git commit -m "test: define onError non-error rejection contract"'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && git log -1 --oneline --decorate && nl -ba src/orchestration/onError.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '20,72p' && nl -ba .lore/dod.md | sed -n '1,80p'"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '110,175p' AGENTS.md; rg -n 'ordinal|#1|spec anchor|test.*spec' AGENTS.md .lore specs -g '*.md' | head -80"
